summary: Every legal input contains exactly three fixed-width RGB channels, so the source contract has no scalable workload dimension on which an honest runtime trend can be measured.

workload_bound.source_constraint: color.length == 7, color[0] is '#', and the remaining six characters form exactly three hexadecimal channel bytes

replacement_checks.evidence: A legal color always has three channels, each byte is one of 256 values, and each shorthand channel is one of sixteen repeated-digit values; no source input can increase the number or width of channels.
The certificate regression independently checks all 256 byte values in each of the three channel positions, both rounding boundaries, every authored case, and both protected source forms.
